title: OpenAI & Gemini Native Function / Tool Calling
why: Native tool calling enables models to emit structured arguments matching your function definitions. The LLM pauses text generation, yields a 	ool_calls payload, waits for your code to execute the tool, and then synthesizes the answer.
objectives: Format tool definitions using OpenAI function schema
Return tool observation messages back into the message array
concept: The model never runs code directly. It simply outputs a structured function call request: {"name": "get_stock", "arguments": "{\"symbol\": \"GOOG\"}"} which your Python loop executes.

practice.description: Construct a function calling schema for a tool named search_knowledge_base with arguments query: str and limit: int.
practice.hint: Set type as object, properties with types and descriptions, and specify required fields.

project.description: Full End-to-End Function Calling Agent Loop
requirements: Send user message with tool schema
Handle tool_calls response, execute mock function, and pass result back to LLM for final reply

checklist: Understood client-server handshake of function calling
Defined JSON Schema properties with types and descriptions
Appended ole: tool message response with matching tool_call_id
mistakes: Mismatching the 	ool_call_id in the returned observation message
